messages:
anika: quick sync - we need a short plan for the smoothing pilot + clear migration for burst credits. low noise, fast pilots.
ben: agree. propose default pilot band = +25% smoothing, with a 30d trial bump to +50%. keeps ops risk low.
lena: sales OK with that. require a pro-rated conversion of existing burst credits so customers aren't double-billed.
marco: infra: need a per-account 30d rolling usage metric + a soft throttle at 1.5x and hard at 3x. estimate 2 infra sprints.
tess: cs input: console should show remaining smoothing headroom and a projected window end estimate. simple UX.
anika: billing behavior during pilot: consume pre-paid first, then bill overage at agreed rate. if abused 3 months in 6, require uplift.
lena: migration: announce 90d sunset for burst credits with opt-in path and credit conversion formula. avoids surprises.
ben: legal note: define "abuse" explicitly (e.g., >50% exceedance in 2/6 months) and timebox clawbacks.
marco: create backlog: PRIC-PILOT-1 billing hooks, PRIC-PILOT-2 metrics & throttles, PRIC-PILOT-3 console UI, PRIC-PILOT-4 legal terms.
anika: KPIs for pilot: pilot accounts, % overage, avg overage $, number of throttles, conversion->paid.
ben: next: ben+lena nominate 3 pilot customers by Fri; marco to confirm infra ETA; i'll draft pricing bands + legal stub EOW. @pricing-bot create epic. :thumbsup:
pricing-bot: Epic PRIC-SMOOTH created (https://go/repo/PRIC-SMOOTH) - owners: anika, marco, ben.
